items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Minimum 2-4 years of experience in an ambulatory setting.
Current employee with UCR Health for a minimum of two years in the ambulatory setting.

Coordination: Serves as a liaison between leadership, operational teams, and external partners by participating on committees and workgroups to communicate organizational changes, emerging issues, current events, and industry trends related to ambulatory services, quality, and training; providing guidance to cross-functional teams to evaluate and improve technical and non-technical quality management systems and operational processes; facilitating collaboration across departments to align operations, quality, utilization, and strategic initiatives; ensuring adherence to organizational standards and effective utilization of technology and process improvement efforts; and coordinating operational and administrative activities that support ambulatory services, including researching and facilitating clinic licensure and regulatory requirements, processing staffing requisitions and onboarding requests, establishing and maintaining vendor relationships and service agreements, coordinating facility readiness and occupancy requirements, supporting contract and document management, maintaining operational records and project documentation, tracking budgets and invoices, monitoring project timelines and deliverables, coordinating equipment, furniture, and supply procurement, facilitating access and technology requests, supporting accreditation and compliance activities, preparing reports and presentations for leadership, and assisting with new clinic openings, program implementations, and other organizational initiatives. (35% time)

Process Improvement & Quality Assurance: Maintains ambulatory operations, service quality, and continuous process improvement by overseeing day-to-day technical and non-technical operations; guiding staff on efficient, standardized practices that promote quality, patient safety, customer satisfaction, and cost effectiveness; evaluating and optimizing workflows and systems across the continuum of care; developing and implementing policies, procedures, and process improvement initiatives; leading internal audits and quality assurance activities to verify compliance and effectiveness of ambulatory processes; reviewing and validating process outcomes, data, and results for accuracy and completeness prior to dissemination; identifying and resolving complex operational and workflow issues; analyzing performance and quality metrics to address deficiencies and drive corrective actions; promoting the adoption of innovative processes and technologies that enhance service, quality, and efficiency; managing inventory, resources, and project initiatives; and fostering collaboration, accountability, and a progressive work environment that supports continuous improvement and operational excellence. (20% time)

Project Management: Provides project management and operational support for ambulatory initiatives, programs, and organizational priorities by coordinating project plans, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder engagement activities; supporting the planning, implementation, and evaluation of new programs and services; facilitating cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment with organizational goals and operational requirements; monitoring project progress, identifying risks and barriers, and developing solutions to maintain project timelines; preparing project documentation, reports, and communications; tracking action items and ensuring accountability for deliverables; and supporting leadership in the successful execution, adoption, and continuous improvement of projects, programs, and operational initiatives. (20% time)
Miscellaneous duties as assigned. (15% time)

Coordination of Ad Hoc Clinic Activations: Coordinates ambulatory clinic activation and operational readiness activities by serving as the central operational resource for new clinic openings and expansion projects; developing, maintaining, and tracking project plans, timelines, deliverables, and activation resources to ensure successful execution of multiple concurrent projects; facilitating communication and collaboration among leadership, clinic managers, physicians, developers, landlords, vendors, and other key stakeholders; monitoring project milestones and proactively identifying, escalating, and resolving risks, barriers, and dependencies; coordinating operational readiness activities including equipment, supplies, staffing, training, regulatory requirements, and facility preparation; supporting go-live planning and execution to ensure a seamless transition to operations; maintaining project documentation and status reporting; and driving accountability across stakeholders to achieve project objectives, timelines, and organizational standards for quality, service, and operational excellence. (10% time)
